tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong dngos grub bsdu ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod bzhugs so// swasti pra dzā bh+yaḥ pad+ma gar dbang rigs kyi gtso/ /thugs rjes khros pa khrag 'thung zhabs/ /dbyer med pad+ma sam bha wa/ /snying nas gus pas phyag bgyi ste/ /yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sngags kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu gsal phyir du/ /dngos grub bsdu ba'i sbyin sreg bshad/ /de la 'dir/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ the tshom dang yid gnyis spangs te dmigs pa rtse gcig pas sngags bzlas shing bsgrubs na myur du grub pa'i mtshan ma 'byung ba yin te/ lo tsā ba chen po be ro tsa nas mdzad pa'i sbas pa mig 'byed gser gyi thur ma las/ sngon du rtsa ba'i drod thob gces/ /dbang dang dam tshig shin tu gces/ /the tshom yid gnyis spang ba gces/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig 'du ba gces/ /gces pa bzhi ldan bsgrubs na 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa las/ 'dir thog mar yi dam gyi lha mnyes shing nye bar byed pa la bsnyen pa gal che zhing / de la yang grangs kyi bsnyen pa/ dus kyi bsnyen pa/ rtags sam/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa dang gsum las/ dang po la slob dpon chen pos 'bum phrag bzhi bzla bar gsungs shing / bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi phyag len la/ yig 'bru'i grangs kyi dbang du byas nas/ yab la 'bum phrag bco lnga/ 'khor rnams la de'i bcu cha khri tsho bco lnga pa re bzla bar bshad/ yab kyi rigs pas yum la'ang de snyed gcig dgos sam snyam/ dus kyi bsnyen pa ni grangs bsnyen tshad du song ba'i gang zag gis/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba sogs la 'jug pa'i skabs su kha gso ba'i tshul du byed pa yin/ rtags kyi bsnyen pa la gser thur las/

phyi yi rtags ni rmi lam dang / /nang rtags nyams su 'byung ba yin/ /gsang ba'i rtags de dngos su mthong / /zhes dang / rtags dang drod tshad 'byung tshul ni/ /phyi rtags rten du bcas pa'i sku /'od 'bar mdangs dang ldan pa rmi/ /nyi zla'i steng du 'phags pa rmi/ /bsnyen pa'i rtags de gsang rgyud las/ sku nyid dngos su mthong ba'am/ /slob dpon nyi zla mgo la 'char/ /rdzas la me 'bar 'od 'phro zhing / /sgrub khang g.yo 'gyur sgra chen 'byung / /rang nyid khro rgyal sku ru gyur/ /snang srid me tog dmar pos khengs/ /sgrub pa'i rtags de gsang rgyud las/ pad+ma'i sdong po bdag 'dug na/ /snang srid me tog pad+mas khengs/ /nyams su myong la zhe 'dod med/ /rang yid ches la khar mi thon/ /brjod med bsam med don de rtogs/ /sgrub chen rtags ni gsang rgyud las/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig chos nyan pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin/ de la 'dir grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i kha bskong ba dang / sngags kyi 'bras bu 'byin pa'i ched du kha bskong ba'i sbyin sreg bya dgos pa yin te/ gser thur las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing / /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byung / /gsang sngags 'bum phrag bzlas nas kyang / /sbyin sreg dag ni khri phrag bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i cho ga'i rim pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi rjes so/ /dang po la/ thab bca' ba dang / rdzas bsham pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sbas pa mig 'byed las/ las bzhi grub pa'i thab khung la/ /rab 'bring mtha' ma'i rim pa yi/ /rgya ni khru gang mtho gang dang / /mtho mdzub 'khyud gang dpangs su bya/ /gting nas gru gsum zla gam gsum/ /gru bzhi zlum po ser mo re/ /rim pa bzhin du mtho bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rab rgyar khru gang / dpangs su de'i phyed mtho gang / 'bring mdzub gang gi dpangs la rgya de'i nyis 'gyur/ tha ma 'khyud gang gi dpangs la rgya nyis 'gyur du bya'o/

/de'i dbus nas rim pa bzhin du/ gru gsum dang / zla gam dang / zlum po dang / gru bzhir byas pa'i bang rim re re bzhin/ sor mo res mtho bar bya'o/ /de yang thab kyi dbyibs ni gru bzhi pa kha khyer mu ran dang ldan par bya/ kha dog ni dmar por bsgyur ro/ rtsig pa ma grub na rdul tshon nam/ chu tshon gyis bris nas bud shing thab kyi tshad du brtsigs pas kyang rung bar gsungs te/ gser thur las/ bshad bzhin ma 'byor shug pa la/ /khru gang mtho gang dpangs kyi tshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de dag ye ma 'byor na/ gnag gi lci ba skam po srog chags med pas kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa rdzas bsham pa la/ bsreg shing dang / yam shing dang / de las gzhan pa'i rdzas so/ /dang po ni gong du bshad pa ltar/ shug pa'am/ 'o ma can gyi shing gang yang rung ba'am/ gnag gi lci ba skam pos gong gi dpangs tshad rab 'bring gsum gang yang rung ba brtsigs pa'i nang gi dbus sam/ shar lho me tshang lag len ltar bca'/ gnyis pa yam shing ni shug pa'am 'o ma can gyi shing sbom phra mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam la/ srid du mdzub gang pa mngar gsum dang mar khus byugs pa bsham/ gsum pa bsreg rdzas dngos ni/ gser thur las/ bsreg pa'i rdzas ni 'di lta ste/ /til dang me tog a mṛ ta/ /byi thang 'bru yi khu byug rtswa/ /ru ta shu dag rgya spos dang / /pri yaṃ ku dang lan tshwa dang / /pad+ma ge sar nā ga pus/ /zhib btags dkar mngar drug gis sbrus/ /ji tsam sreg pa'i ril bu bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyas pa'i rdzas lnga dang / dbang gi rdzas bdun po de dag zhib par btags la dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i ril bu sran chung ngam yungs dkar gyi 'bru tshad tsam ci rigs pa grangs tshang ba bsham/ gzhan yang / mngar gsum bskus pa'i me tog dang / /zhes gsungs pas me tog lug ru dmar po la sogs pa dri zhim pa'i me tog dmar po'i rigs sam/ 'bras sam nas dkar mo mtshal lam 'bri mog gis kha dog bsgyur ba gang rigs de rnams mngar gsum gyis sbags pa bsham/

de bzhin du rtsi mar gyi khu ba 'bri mog gis kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba'am/ ma 'byor na ma bsgyur kyang rung bas ci 'byor ba legs par bsham/ mchod rdzas ni/ phyi lnga nang gsum mchod pa bsham/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / sman raka gtor gsum rnams bsham/ de yang thab kyi g.yas su bsreg rdzas dang / g.yon du mchod rdzas rnams bkod/ mdun dgang blug kha sbyar/ rdo rje dril bu rlung g.yab sogs nyer mkho rnams ma tshang ba med par bsham mo/ /de nas gser thur las/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa yis/ /thun gsum mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum ste thun drug gi rim pa'am yang na 'phrin las thun bzhir gzhung bsrang / gang ltar 'dzab bstod yan chad dkyus bzhin nyams su blangs te sbyar ba'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gser thur las/ bsreg rdzas 'bru gsum byin rlabs bya/ /thab gsang me sbar me srog bzung / /thugs ka'i hrīḥlas raṃ chad de/ /raṃ las me lha dmar ser ni/ /rwa zhon me dar lcags kyu thogs/ /oṃ ag+ne dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyis/ /dgug gzhug gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgya yis btab/ /phyi lnga nang gsum bdun du dbul/ /bsreg pa'i rdzas kyang bdun du dbul/ /rtsi thog mar yang thengs gsum dbul/ /ces gsungs pas phyi mchod/ sman raka gtor gsum dang bcas pa phrin las kyi dkyus ltar byin gyis brlab/ bsreg rdzas ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ ma las nyi ma/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ a las zla ba/ nyi zla ga'u kha sbyar gyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bsreg rdzas rnams ro brgya dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsam la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ de nas thab la nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ raṃ kro dha'i sngags kyis bgegs bsangs/ swa bha was me thab stong par bsams/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang drag gi thab khung dmar po/ rgya dang tshad yongs su ma chad pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran la pad+ma dang bhan+dha/ lcags kyu dang rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'phro bar bsam/ de'i dbus su ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhi las rwa skyes kham pa/ de'i steng du rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pa'i raṃ yig dmar ser/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ drang srong me lha'i rgyal po sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ 'dzum zhing 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas me dar dmar po g.yob cing / g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ag tshom can/ kriṇa sā ri'i lpags pa dang / tshangs pa'i skud pa'i mchod phyir thogs 'phyang ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho mtshams na bzhugs pa'i me lha ye shes pa'i thugs kar phog pas thugs brgyud bskul bar bsam/ de nas/ dpal 'bar sbar ba thab la lan gsum bskor zhing / oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ tshar gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ thab nang gi me tshang du me sbar la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ hoḥme lha drang song gi rgyal po khyed/ sngon lha'i gnas su sbyin sreg 'tshal/ deng bdag cag gi mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bsgrub pa'i slad du/ sbyin sreg gi mchod pa la spyan 'dren/ mchod pa 'bul lags na/ thugs rje dang dam tshig gi dbang gis 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/

oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ de nas me dar ram/ rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing / hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong bram ze'i mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ /ag+ne ye de ba ri ṣi dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa shar lho nas byon te/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtswa rtse ma nyams pa las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag rnams la bgegs med cing zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes brjod cing g.yas skor gyis thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkram/ me srog bzung ba'i don du mar khu dgang blugs gsum byon zan gyi tshul du 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i rtser raṃ dang / dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ gyis mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā/ zhes pa bdun gyis sngags pa'i blugs gzar gyis dgang gzar nang du blug mthar dgang blugs kha sbyar te/ thab la g.yas skor gyis bskor zhing / oṃ ag+ne ye di bya di bya bi shud+dhe/ mahā shrī ha bya ka bya bha ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pas dbus su dbul/ slar yang de 'dra tshar gnyis te/ tshar gsum dbul/ bdug spos snang gsal sogs kyi mjug tu/ ag+ne ye de wa ri ṣa argaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta pra ti ts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes sngags dang bcas pas phyi mchod tshar bdun dbul/ oṃ ag+ne ye de wa ri ṣi ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ/ khā hi/ zhes dang / ag+ne yi de wa ri ṣ-i ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ ag+ne ye de wa ri ṣi ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ/ zhes pas sman raka gtor gsum lan bdun bdun dbul/ de nas bsreg rdzas dbul ba dngos ni/ drang srong chen po sngon chad ma brdar ba'i/ /ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi 'di/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags kyis/ /ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ag+ne ye de wa ri ṣi ha bya ka bya ma hā na ya/ ti bya mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa dang khyad par lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes brjod la/ thog mar ril bu/ de nas me tog de nas yaṃ shing rnams re re'ang tshar bdun bdun sngags dang spel tshig de nyid kyis dbul/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas rigs kyi sprul pa mchog /me yi lha ni snang mtha' yas/ /me yi lha mo gos dkar mo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'od mchog ste/ /'byung ba me la dbang bsgyur cing / /thams cad kun gyi srog bdag yin/ /snang srid sreg par zhal gyis bzhes/ /'khor ba sreg pa'i 'phrin las ma/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis yongs mi 'da'/ /me yi las gnyer gtad bya'i phyir/ /me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ hoḥme lha drang song gi rgyal po khyed la 'phrin las su gsol ba ni/ sngon thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ me 'bar ba dang gnyis su med par bzhugs nas sbyin sreg gi zhal zas rnams bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i zhal du bstab pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab cing / badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas mar blugs gzar gang thab tu phul bas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i tshul la don lnga ste/ lha bskyed pa dang / de la mchod pa dang / bsreg rdzas 'bul ba/ smon lam btab pa/ bstod pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gser thur las/ me lha zhu nas me ru 'bar/ /de klong dbang chen dkyil 'khor ni/ /snying po tsam gyi chu bur tshul/ /dbang bskur spyan drangs phyag rgyas bstim/ /zhes gsungs pa/ thab la nang mchod gtor zhing / oṃ raṃ sogs mtshams sngags kyi bgegs bsangs/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs la/ bh+rūṃ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūṃ/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na kro dhi shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma kro dhi shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karmā kro dhi shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ban+dha kā pa la bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ/hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ swā rat+na he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hā karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ e h+yi hi bha ga wan ma hā kā ru ṇi ka tri sh+ya hoḥ sa mā ya dzaḥ sa mā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ ces rang rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya'o/ /dam tshig dbang gis dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /ye shes dbang chen dkyil 'khor mchog /pho brang dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/

'di ni gser thur gyi dngos bstan ltar bris pa yin la/ spros pa la dga' zhing rgyas par 'dod na mngon rtogs kyi dkyus ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /gnyis pa de la mchod pa ni/ gser thur las/ bskyed sngags mchod pas mtha' bsgyur la/ /phyi lnga nang gsum nyer gcig bgrang / /zhes gsungs pas/ hūm̐/ bdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra/ /zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang / /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /thugs rjes dgongs la dngos grub stsol/ /hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta pra ti ts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes phyag rgyar bcas pas nyer gcig 'bul/ de bzhin du gong gi sngags kyi mjug tu/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hī/ ma hā ba ling ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes nyer gcig dbul/ gsum pa bsreg rdzas dbul ba la/ thog mar byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i zhal gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i rtse mo la hūm̐ dang raṃ/ dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ gyis mtshan par bsams la/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun brjod pas bsngags shing / blugs gzar gyis dgang gzar gyi nang du mar khu blugs pa'i mthar dgang blugs kha sbyar te/ thab la g.yas skor gyis bskor zhing dbus su phul la/ u ta kro ta ya ra ga ra ga a ti u ti ya ra ga ra ga pad+ma ban+dha ya ra ga ra ga dz+wa la raṃ kha raṃ khā hi/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub lha mi'i dpal 'byor/ skye 'gro thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ ces brjod la/ slar yang de lta bu tshar gnyis dbul/ sbyin sreg dngos gzhi ni/ gser thur las/ rdzas re sngags res dbul bar bya/ /de yi gsang sngags 'di lta ste/ u ta kro ya zhes pa nas kha raṃ khā hi'i bar gsungs pa ltar/

gong gi sngags tshar re'i mthar ril bu re phul ba nyer gcig la bdun bdun gyi mtshams su bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sogs gong ltar brjod/ de bzhin du me tog yaṃ shing / mar khu rnams la'ang sngags re rdzas re spel ba'i nyer gcig re bdun gyi mtshams su 'dod don gsol gdab gong ltar bya/ de rjes grangs kyi dngos gzhi u ta kro ta'i sngags dang rdzas kyi ril bu la 'dzin pa yin pas thun re la ji tsam 'gro ba dbul/ bar skabs su yaṃ shing dang mar khu ni me'i tshod dang sbyar te dbul ba ma gtogs nges pa mi dgos/ bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ smon lam zhes gsungs pa'i don/ hoḥn mo dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa la bye brag gi mchod pa tshul bzhin du phul bas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes te bzhes shing longs spyod par gyur cig de'i byin rlabs kyis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dug gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i las ngan pa'i bag chags thams cad dag cing / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs te/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi zhal mngon sum du mthong bar gyur cig gnas skabs su'ang lha dang mi'i dpal dang 'byor pas skye 'gro thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum dbang du 'dus nas dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la dgod par gyur cig ces brjod/ lnga pa bstod pa ni/ gser thur las/ bstod dang zhes gsungs pa'i don/ gsang rgyud las byung ba'i/ hriḥrang bzhin chos kyi sku las rang byung ba/ /zhes sogs sam/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i/ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs gang yang rung bas bstod/ de'i rjes su yum la sogs pa'i lha gzhan rnams la'ang gong gi 'phror byung ba'i sbyin sreg dbul ba'i tshul ni/

gser thur las/ de nas de'i 'phror za byed sbar zhes gsungs pas/ yum la mtshon na/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ar+ghaṃ sogs phyi lnga nang gsum gyis gong ltar nyer gcig gis mchod/ de nas u ta kro ta'i sngags dang / rdzas re spel ba'i ril bu dang / me tog dang / yaṃ shing dang / mar khu rnams nyer gcig re dbul/ de rjes ril bu dang de'i sngags kyi bcu cha'i grangs thun re la ji ltar thob pa dbul/ smon lam ni/ hoḥn mo dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang yum chen khro bo gar gyi dbang phyug ma la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa tshul bzhin du phul bas zhes sogs gong ltar brjod/ bstod pa ni/ khro rgyal dbang chen sku yi g.yon phyogs na/ /zhes sogs sam/ dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /zhes sogs gang rung gis bstod par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor rnams la 'bul tshul ni/ gser thur las/ rigs bzhi sgo ma bzhi rnams la/ /mchod pa lha rdzas bdun du 'bul/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sogs kyis 'go drangs pa'i phyi lnga nang gsum rnams lan bdun pa re re dbul/ de bzhin du ril bu/ me tog yaṃ shing / mar khu rnams la'ang u ta kro ta'i sngags re dang spel ba'i lan bdun pa re dbul/ dngos gzhi/ rdzas ril bu dang sngags u ta kro ta spel bas bcu cha'i grangs dbul/ so so'i mjug tu/ hoḥn mo dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje dbang chen la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa tshul bzhin du phul bas zhes dang / ye shes kyi khro bo sgo ma rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa phul bas zhes sogs kyis smon lam gdab/ yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /shar phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng du/ /zhes sogs so so'i bstod pa bya/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i rjes su sngar ltar dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum gyis mchod pa tshar gsum mam gcig dbul/

bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol zhes sogs dang / pad+ma he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha bskang / de nas mig 'byed las/ rang la bskyed bsdu me lha mchod/ /ye shes me lha gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig me lha rang la bsdu/ /zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyis mjug tu/ badz+ra muḥbatags pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la bsdu'o/ /de nas mig 'byed las/ thab tu me lha gong bzhin bskyed/ /sngar bzhin mchod la rang gnas gshegs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blug cing / ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las skad cig gis rang gzugs su byon par bsams la/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ phyi lnga nang gsum bsreg rdzas bzhi dang bcas pa tshar bdun gyi bar du dbul/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas rigs kyi sprul pa mchog /ces sogs kyis bstod/ gong ltar dgang blugs bdun tshar gsum gyis gshegs skyems dbul/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs dang yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha bskang / ag+ne ye badz+ra muḥs me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang gi snying gar thim par bsam mo// //gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ gser thur las/ thal ba'i dngos grub tshig sngags blang / /'byung po lhag mas tshim par byas/ /smon lam gdab dang bkra shis brjod/ /thal ba chu bo'i gzhung la bskyal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ me rang shugs kyis shi ba'am/ cung zad ring na 'o ma dang dri bzang gis chus zhi bar byas la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a la la hoḥ zhes brjod cing thal ba rang gi smin mtshams su cung zad byug la dngos grub thob par bsams te/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/

/zhes sogs smon lam dang / bkra shis gang zhig lhag lha'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /zhes sogs kyis shis pa brjod/ thal ba lhag ma rnams rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo chen po'i gzhung la dor bar bya'o/ /de ltar dngos grub bsdu ba'i bsreg blugs kyi/ /cho ga 'di ni dbang chen gsang rgyud dang / /bai ro'i gzhung bzhin brgyud pa'i gsung sgros kyis/ /legs par brgyan nas lag len gsal bar bkod/ /gang 'di rje btsun bla ma'i thugs sras mchog /ban bon zung 'jug bdud rtsi'i bcud len mkhan/ /ḍā ki zung gis bsten pa'i grub pa'i dbang / /chos kyi rje bo stobs ldan 'od zer gyi/ /gsung gis bskul nas rgyal khams yangs pa'i ljongs/ /phyogs med 'khyams pa'i ban sprang ku sa li/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho gang gi rnam dpyod blos/ /bskrun pa'i dge bas dbang chen 'grub par shog /rnying mar rlom pa'i mun khrod la 'thams shing / /gsar mar rlom pa'i sgrim pos ma bslad pa'i/ /dbang chen brgyud pa'i rang gzhung rta skad ni/ /sangs por 'tsher nus rnal 'byor blo gsal yin/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /'di'i yi ge pa ni rje nyid kyi bran g.yog mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bgyis pa'o// // ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dir tshogs skal ldan rdo rje'i bu/ /snying gi ze'u 'bru dad pas phye/ /mig gi pad+mo mkha' dbyings ltos/ /yid la bde chen dga' ba skyongs/ /mdun phyogs dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /rje btsun bla ma tshe dpag med/ /'chi med rig 'dzin bye bas bskor/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung stibs/ /'dzab dbyangs rdo rje'i 'brug stong 'dir/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /bde ldan yangs pa'i zhing khams nas/ /'chi med rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ /tshe yi lha dang lha mos bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la bkra shis stsol/ /pad+ma dbang gi pho brang nas/

khro rgyal pad+ma he ru ka /tshe yi khro bo khro mos bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon laྎ /rnga yab dpal ri'i rtse mo nas/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas de/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros bskor/ /gnas 'dirྎ /rgya bod phyogs bcu'i gnas chen nas/ /tshe yi brgyud ldan bla ma la/ /mched lcam dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /lag gnyis pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser/ /'chi med dngos grub tshe yi rdzas/ /longs shig skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /lo brgya 'tsho ba'i bkra shis shog /dpal gyi zas mchog ril bu bde/ /'khor 'das tshe bcud bsdus pa'i sman/ /zhes pas 'chi bdag bdud bcom nas/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /snying po lnga ldan rigs lnga'i bcud/ /ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /myangs pas rdo rje'i lus khengs nas/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /a wa dhu ti'i sgo 'phar na/ /zla gam dmar po'i klong dkyil du/ /tshe yi sgo srung rta mgrin dbang / /bar chad bdud 'joms bkra shis shog /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i tshe dbang gi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu phrag gcig pa 'di/ yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis sbyar ba/ /maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
